name: duopore-public-application-followup-draft
description: Write a polite job application follow-up from facts you have checked.

interface.longDescription: Write a polite job application follow-up from facts you have checked. Share the role, employer, application date and the update you want to ask for. Confirm the facts before the draft is built. Use labels instead of email addresses. For adults following up on their own applications. You review and send the message yourself; the app sends nothing.
defaultPrompt: Draft a polite follow-up for this job application.
Ask the hiring team for an update using these confirmed facts.
